messages:
Sam W (Support): FYI @Aria - Crestline Health trial hit a big activation surge and their session state is getting dropped. Support saw repeated `503` on the dedicated inference pool and a burst of ingest requests from their onboarding job. Customer is unhappy; flagged as renewal-risk if not stabilized today. Marking P0 and asking CS for comms + enablement.
Aria - CS: Thanks Sam. Can you paste the short timeline and error snippet? Also want to decide immediate customer message. Do we have a fallback we can propose? :rotating_light:
Sam W (Support): Timeline: 14:03 first 503, 14:07 spike to 90 req/s, 14:09 autoscaler failed to add enough capacity, 14:11 consecutive 504s. Logs:
```
[14:07:03] req_id=abcd status=503 model=redwood-embed worker=pod-23 error="kv cache OOM"
[14:07:08] req_id=abce status=503 model=redwood-chat worker=pod-23 error="queue full"
```
We also have their ingest job hitting retries every 200ms. Support recommends throttle or temp quota bump. deploy-bot noted a scaling delay on the dedicated pool.
deploy-bot: ALERT: autoscaler delayed adding pods due to GPU availability in region us-west-2. Incident ID: INC-3012
Luca R (Solutions): Quick mitigation options: 1) Apply a short-term quota bump for Crestline to absorb onboarding traffic; 2) Temporarily route onboarding traffic to a pooled instance (lower perf but stable); 3) Ask them to throttle ingest to 5 req/s per worker. I can push a routing rule if we get approval.
Priya K (Onboarding): I can pause their bulk ingest and run a controlled ramp. Marta, can you run an enablement call to walk them through the recommended ingest flow? We should capture any prompt templates that cause large sequences.
Marta (Onboard): I can take the 16:00 PT slot for an enablement/ops session. I'll prepare a short deck: cause, short-term fixes, long-term best practices. Also want to collect their sample ingestion job to reproduce.
Jared AE: We should offer a goodwill credit if the outage hit their trial experience. Also want the customer-facing note: short, honest, and plans-by-time. Draft idea: "We're sorry for the disruption — we've applied a temporary fix and scheduled an ops session at X. We'll follow up with a permanent config change." Thoughts?
Aria - CS: Agree with the message. Draft comms plan below — send after we've confirmed mitigations:
- T0 (now): Acknowledge, apologize, explain we have an ops ticket and an enablement call scheduled.
- T+1h: Confirm temporary mitigation (quota bump / routing) applied.
- T+6h: Post-call summary + replayable steps + timeline for permanent fix.
- Owner: Aria (primary comms), Sam (tech notes), Marta (enablement session)
Sam W (Support): I can apply the throttle rule now if CS greenlights. If we go quota bump, need AE signoff for billing/credits.
Jared AE: I approve a single-day trial credit and will notify finance if they want longer. :thumbsup:
Aria - CS: OK locking this down. Marta please send calendar invite to Crestline ops + product at 16:00 PT. Sam apply throttle rule (5 req/s) and post confirmation here. I'll send the customer note template in 15 mins for AE to approve.
Marta (Onboard): Calendar invite sent to crestline@crestlinehealth.com and their ops alias. Prep materials in #cs-playbooks and will attach after the session.
Sam W (Support): Throttle rule applied to crestline-tenant (5 req/s). Monitoring for errors now. Will update in 10.
Aria - CS: Great. Capture feedback after the call and I'll open a follow-up item with product for improved autoscaler telemetry. Thanks everyone. :pray:
